facts.text: Hunter Cabot's toast before El Dorado.
facts.why: On the riverboat Hunter says 'So, a toast... to finding Aunt Lucy', just before the group learns about Rumi Rock and El Dorado.

vibe.verdict: A friendly hotel menu with real Paddington jokes, though most of the Peru set pieces are missing.
missing: 'I appear to be driving the boat!' (the river)
Rumi Rock and the map in Aunt Lucy's cabin (Home for Retired Bears)
El Dorado as an orangery where the bears make marmalade (finale)
The Reverend Mother's welcome song with guitar (the Home)
Hunter's boat, 'smooth, strong, easy on the eye' (river)
ideas: Swap 'Peruvian chicken causa bites' for a 'Never touch this plant' jungle salad.
Swap 'Alfajores' for 'El Dorado orangery marmalade tarts'.
Swap the pisco sour house line for a boat-captain mocktail named after Hunter's boat.
Swap 'Choclo with queso fresco' note for the river driving gag.
